subject: Re: Temporary purchase-exemption request for Avalon Cloud onboarding
messages:
From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@avaloncloud.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, procurement@redwood.com
Cc: Mark Li <mark.li@avaloncloud.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Temporary PO exemption request for Avalon Cloud onboarding

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking the call today — excited to get Avalon Cloud into the pilot. We have a quick administrative ask: our finance team cannot issue a purchase order for pilots under $25k until after an initial invoice is accepted on our side. That means we need a temporary "no-PO" path so we can prepay the pilot invoice and move forward next week.

We attached the signed SOW and our W-9. Key items:
- Pilot term: 1 month, $12,500 (prepay)
- Billing contact: billing@avaloncloud.com
- Legal: Avalon Cloud, Inc.

Can Redwood provision a short-term exception or a delegated invoicing path? If it helps, I can share our approved vendor profile and we can sign whatever temporary addendum you need (DocuSign link below).

Attachments: Avalon_Onboarding_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 220KB); Avalon_tax_w9.pdf (PDF, 45KB)
DocuSign: https://docusign.net/sign/avalon-sow-2026

Thanks,
Sonia Patel
Head of Partnerships
Avalon Cloud
sonia.patel@avaloncloud.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@avaloncloud.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T08:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary PO exemption request for Avalon Cloud onboarding

Hi Sonia — appreciate the SOW and context. Looping in Aditya (account lead) and Grace (finance) to evaluate a short-term path.

Quick ask from our side so we can speed review:
- Please complete the vendor intake form here: https://redwood.app/vendor-intake (or attach a completed copy)
- Confirm bank wiring vs card payment for the prepay invoice
- Provide a point of contact for invoicing and tax verification

If Aditya can confirm deal cadence and PO risk profile, Grace can propose an approval lane (temporary exemption, prepay exception, or delegated approver). We typically restrict no-PO pilot exceptions to <30 days with controls (net-new vendor checks, limited spend cap, and ledger tagging).

Will reconvene once we have the intake form and payment method.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@avaloncloud.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Li <mark.li@avaloncloud.com>, procurement@avaloncloud.com
Date: 2026-10-03T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary PO exemption request for Avalon Cloud onboarding

Thanks Vanessa — attached is a completed vendor intake (vendor-intake-avalon-response.xlsx) and confirmation that Avalon will prepay via wire. Billing contact is billing@avaloncloud.com; accounts team can provide remittance once Redwood issues invoice.

We cannot issue a PO today because:
- New vendor in our ERP; PO capability requires a supplier setup that typically takes 2-3 weeks
- Pilot is time-sensitive and prepay is our approved mechanism for short trials

I included Mark (finance) in case there are compliance questions. We are happy to accept an exception with any reasonable controls Redwood needs (short term, capped to pilot amount, and a take-down clause if issues arise).

Attachments: vendor-intake-avalon-response.xlsx

Sonia

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Temporary PO exemption request for Avalon Cloud onboarding

Folks — forwarding Avalon thread. TL;DR: 1-month pilot, $12.5k prepay, vendor intake done, Avalon can't issue PO for onboarding window. They can wire funds on receipt of invoice.

Proposed options (quick):
- Finance grants temporary invoice-only lane for this vendor for 30 days with spend cap = $12.5k, require remittance proof before service activation
- Or require escrow of funds (not preferred)

Goal is to avoid losing momentum; Avalon has strong product fit for our pilot. Grace — can you weigh in on controls required and the approval chain? Lauren — any procurement flags on vendor risk or preferred docs?

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary PO exemption request for Avalon Cloud onboarding

Team — after reviewing the intake and the SOW, finance will approve a temporary no-PO exception with the following conditions:

1) Timebox: 30 days from invoice date (no renewals without formal vendor setup in ERP)
2) Spend cap: $12,500 (pilot amount)
3) Evidence: copy of wire confirmation or cleared funds must be provided to finance before provisioning
4) Controls: vendor classified as Tier C (pilot supplier) with periodic review; no PII processing beyond test data; standard data processing addendum signed
5) Ledger: assign project code PRJ-AC-761 and tagging mandatory on invoice

Please confirm acceptance by Avalon via a signed one-page addendum (we will prepare) and upload proof of payment when complete. I will copy Procurement (Lauren) on the addendum for recordkeeping.

Vanessa — if you can ask Sonia to sign the addendum, finance can issue an invoice and we can provision the pilot the same day we receive wire confirmation.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
[Attachment: temporary-no-po-addendum-template.docx]
